newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots FY97 EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots FY97 EPS cut.

text.p: JP Morgan Securities analyst Maura Hunter Byrne said Wednesday she cut her earnings estimates for retailer Talbots Inc to $1.32 a share from $2.02 for fiscal 1997 ending in January 1998.

-- She also reduced her estimate for the second quarter to a loss of $0.34 a share from a profit of $0.23; for the third quarter to a profit of $0.66 from $0.72, and for the fourth quarter to a profit of $0.50 from $0.57.
-- This followed Talbot's announcement late Tuesday that it expected to report a second quarter loss of $0.28 to $0.38 a share.

-- In a statement, Talbots blamed the projected second-quarter loss on weak semi-annual sales performance during the last 10 days of fiscal June and the anticipated continuation of these sales trends into July.
-- Talbots said it continued to expect positive quarterly sales and earnings comparisons for the third and fourth quarters, and that it would remain "solidly profitable" for the full year.
-- Byrne said her rating on the stock remains market performer.
